resources.string: Any UVC “plug and play, no driver” USB webcam works. Outside the car it must be waterproof, or mount a normal webcam inside, behind the rear windscreen. That stays dry and works surprisingly well.
Run the cable to the dash
A USB 2.0 extension from the boot to the dash. 5 m is the passive limit, beyond that use an active (repeater) extension. Then a USB-C OTG adapter into the tablet.
Cut only the red +5 V wire

Splice the extension somewhere convenient and cut only the red +5 V wire. Route both ends through a 12 V relay’s normally-open contacts. D+, D− and GND stay joined. With no 5 V the webcam is electrically dead and Android sees it as unplugged, which is exactly the trigger we want.
Drive the relay off the reverse light

Relay coil + to the reverse lamp’s positive wire, coil − to chassis ground. Relay modules have a flyback diode built in; with a bare relay, put a 1N4007 across the coil. The car’s 12 V never touches the USB data lines.

Shift into reverse → lamp powers the coil → contacts close → the webcam appears on USB → Android auto-launches CarApp full screen, over the lockscreen. Leave reverse → the camera loses power → CarApp closes itself.

Reverse lamp +12V ─────────┐
Reverse lamp GND ───────┐ │
 │ │ (coil)
 ┌──┴──┴──┐
 │ RELAY │
 └──┬───┬──┘
 │ │ (N/O contacts)
USB ext red (+5V) ──────┘ └────── continues to webcam
 …D+, D−, GND pass through uncut…

TABLET ─[OTG]─[USB ext, +5V via relay]─[WEBCAM]

• Screen lock must be Swipe or None. Showing over the lockscreen does not work over a PIN or pattern lock.

• Keep OTG enabled. Some Samsung and Xiaomi tablets switch OTG off again after it sits idle.

• Turn off battery optimisation for CarApp so Android does not kill it.

• Grant Camera and Microphone once. Camera: the video will not start without it. Microphone: the webcam has a mic, and without it Android re-asks on every plug-in and refuses to remember “always open CarApp”.

• Charging: while the tablet powers the webcam it usually cannot charge on the same port. Use a powered USB-C hub that supports host + charge, or a Qi pad.
